changelog: Sales lead page: a "Hand over" button opens the board's hand-off dialog (#3672) — same `POST /api/sales/leads/[id]/handoff`, same rule — and takes the rep back to `/sales` once the record has left their book (#3657).

en: Lead page: hand a lead to a colleague right from its page, with the next step for them.
tr: Müşteri adayı sayfası: adayı, yapılacak sonraki adımla birlikte doğrudan sayfasından bir iş arkadaşına devredin.
de: Lead-Seite: Einen Lead direkt von seiner Seite an eine Kollegin oder einen Kollegen übergeben, mit dem nächsten Schritt.
